_comment: The direction audit (./dev.sh audit direction): setup must work in a repo that has never heard of the delegation layer, so its code, data, templates and tests may not reach for it. `paths` are regexes for the layer's files; `roster_names` are its agent names that are not also repo names (those are caught by the content audit, which discovers repos). This list is a copy of names it cannot read, so it can go stale: TODO.md says so. `allowed_phrases` are stripped before matching: the agent/server components must print the owner of that lane, per PLAN-tools-folder.md §4.
